memory_objects.content: 記憶系統將「重要性」與「活化度」分開處理，是為了一個關鍵的設計理由：「重要性」是創建時設定的靜態值，代表一個想法的內在價值，以保存其原始評價；而「活化度」是一個隨時間衰減的動態參數，代表當前的可及性。這樣做可以避免因時間流逝而改變對一個想法價值的根本判斷。

memory_objects.content: A core, unresolved design decision exists regarding the memory architecture. The choice is between a time-based hierarchy (grouping ideas by meeting) and a topic-based structure (grouping ideas by theme). This decision is tied to how the system handles updates: either by creating new nodes for each mention to preserve the context of each meeting, or by updating a single existing node to track an idea's evolution over time. The team is debating which approach better represents the "context" (脈絡) of discussions.
